Play with a
purpose.

Every part of a Kabira day — from a story at circle time to a quiet moment of rest — is built around how young children actually grow, not around a syllabus.

LEARNING BEYOND BOOKS

To nurture their
natural curiosity.

A seed in the soil. A question at storytime. An idea made with little hands. Children learn through experiences that invite them to explore, not just listen.

WHOLE-CHILD DEVELOPMENT

More than learning.
Learning to be.

Inspired by Sant Kabir's wisdom, we believe education should nurture a curious mind and a kind heart alongside strong foundations in language and number.

01 / GROW

With confidence.

A secure, encouraging environment where children feel seen, heard and understood.

02 / LEARN

With curiosity.

Play, conversation, creativity and real experiences that invite independent thinking.

03 / BLOOM

In their own way.

Space for each child's personality, strengths and unique potential to shine, at their own pace.

HOW WE THINK ABOUT DEVELOPMENT

Learning that develops
the whole child.

Early development isn't one subject — it's several areas growing together. This is how Kabira thinks about it, in the classroom and beyond.

LANGUAGE & COMMUNICATION

Finding the words.

Listening, speaking, vocabulary and early literacy grow through conversation, stories and rhymes.

EARLY NUMERACY & THINKING

Making sense of patterns.

Counting, sorting, comparing and simple reasoning build number sense through play.

PHYSICAL & MOTOR DEVELOPMENT

Growing in the body, too.

Movement, fine-motor activities and outdoor play build coordination and physical confidence.

SOCIAL & EMOTIONAL GROWTH

Learning alongside others.

Sharing, turn-taking and group play build empathy, cooperation and emotional security.

CREATIVITY & EXPRESSION

Saying it another way.

Art, music, movement and imaginative play give children ways to express what they think and feel.

VALUES, INDEPENDENCE & LIFE SKILLS

Growing up, a little.

Good manners, self-help and small responsibilities grow alongside academic learning, not apart from it.

VALUES & LIFE SKILLS

Manners and
kindness, practised daily.

Sharing a toy, saying thank you, waiting for a turn — at Kabira, these small moments matter as much as any worksheet. Read about our values ↗
